worktree_at_start.note: Other seats' modifications and untracked files (including the perf directory) were left byte-identical; only the two files below were written.

module_interface.interface: load_evidence(directory) offline evidence reading and size rejection
direct_dependencies: Python stdlib (argparse, hashlib, json, math, pathlib, sys)

problem: load_evidence() checked path.stat().st_size against MAX_BYTES and then called path.read_bytes(), an unbounded convenience read. If the record grew or was replaced inside that TOCTOU window, the 64 MiB promise was bypassed: the whole file was pulled into memory before a post-hoc length check. The same unbounded read_bytes() was used for the 'Evidence changed while reading' re-read.
change: _read_bounded(path, limit) enforces the cap on bytes actually consumed: it requests at most limit + 1 bytes and returns None when more than limit bytes were read, so an oversized record is rejected without ever buffering it.
A record is accepted only after EOF (or when the consumed bytes are within the limit), so an accepted record is the complete file and never a silently truncated prefix.
path.stat() is retained only as an advisory fast reject; the bounded read is what holds when the stat value is stale.
The growth/replacement rejection reports 'the file grew or was replaced after the size check' instead of the removed post-hoc message.
The 'Evidence changed while reading' verification re-read now uses the same bounded reader; a record grown past the limit is reported as a change, not as evidence.
files[name] bytes/sha256 and every record raw_sha256 are computed from the exact bytes consumed by the bounded read.
preserved_semantics: Symlink outside the run directory is still refused with 'Refusing evidence symlink outside run'.

Diagnostics unchanged: missing_file, invalid_result, malformed_record, unterminated_last_line, nonfinite_values, identity_mismatch, unknown_run_identity, source_time_regression, sequence_discontinuity.
Original JSON text (raw_json) and stream-then-original-line order are preserved.
Clock domains stay separate: physics, fc_boot, ros, unknown; receive_clock remains wall_elapsed:<stream>.
reader_status/mode/order/clock_mapping strings and the 'stop the run first' guard message are unchanged.
No physical re-simulation, no interpolation of old logs, no new inference of time from row number.

tests.runner: python -m pytest (Python 3.13.11, pytest 9.1.1, offline; no runtime/native/SITL/model/ROS/UE/MATLAB)
covered: record exactly at the limit is accepted, complete, and hashed over all consumed bytes
empty record at limit 0 accepted; one byte over the limit rejected
stale stat size cannot bypass the read cap (real file, stat lies, reader double observes request cap)
real-file read is capped with no reader double: rejection comes from the read, not the stat
file replaced between stat and read is rejected
reader that keeps growing is rejected, never accepted as truncated evidence
reader that ignores the requested size is still capped: exactly limit + 1 bytes requested
short reads are joined and the recorded hash binds the consumed bytes
change during the verification re-read is rejected and that re-read is bounded too
verification re-read grown past the limit is a change, not evidence
no unbounded Path.read_bytes call in the record path (patched to raise)
rejection performs no network, process, or filesystem write, and leaves no sticky state
diagnostics, line order, raw text, and clock domains survive the bounded reader
symlink outside the run refused (path double, plus a real-link case when the host permits)

red_before_fix.observed: 8 failed, 7 passed, 1 skipped against HEAD replay.py (fd2212a4) before the change

probe_result.after_fix_outcome: result.json exceeds offline reader limit 64 bytes; the file grew or was replaced after the size check

boundaries_not_verified: The real-symlink test is skipped on this Windows host (WinError 1314, no symlink privilege); the refusal branch is covered only through a Path.resolve double here.

No test reads a real 64 MiB record: MAX_BYTES is asserted unchanged at 64 * 1024 * 1024 and the cap behaviour is exercised with small limits, so the full-size path is bounded by construction, not measured end to end.
No same-process test of a genuinely concurrently growing file: the race is exercised with stale-stat real files and reader doubles, not with a live writer process.
Peak buffered bytes for an accepted read is <= MAX_BYTES + 1 per chunk, with a transient join copy for multi-chunk reads (<= 2 * (limit + 1)); that peak was not measured on a large real record.
Only the Windows checkout was exercised; POSIX (including the WSL acceptance candidate) was not run.
Only the offline reader and its direct dependents were run; the wider validation suite and any console GUI interaction were not re-run.
not_done_and_still_required: No git add, commit, or push; no GitHub comment or issue action; no change to /root/wksim-release-acceptance-fe3 or any frozen historical workspace.
No native, build, SITL, ROS node, UE, MATLAB, or vendor-model execution, and no flight re-run.
G4 complete-log obligation remains open and still needs parent acceptance; this receipt accepts neither the evidence reader for release nor any prior PASS.
